edges.reason: transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership updates newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to the zero address.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] using its parameter.
balanceOf returns a value from the balances mapping.
transfer acts on msg.sender's balance entry.
msg.sender keys the balances mapping inside transfer.
The to parameter keys the recipient balance write in transfer.
The tokens parameter drives the arithmetic in transfer.
transfer performs sub and add balance arithmetic.
The resulting arithmetic writes updated values into balances.
approve sets the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
The spender parameter is the second allowance key in approve.
The tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.

allowance reads from the allowed mapping.

The tokenAddress parameter determines the external call target.

The external token contract executes during the call and can reenter the caller.

The _amount parameter is checked against batchlimits and cap.

mint enforces the cap state variable.

SafeMath.add adds its first operand parameter.
SafeMath.add adds its second operand parameter.
SafeMath.add returns the sum through the local result c.
SafeMath.sub subtracts its first operand parameter.
SafeMath.sub subtracts its second operand parameter.
SafeMath.sub returns the difference through the local result c.
SafeMath.mul multiplies its first operand parameter.
SafeMath.mul multiplies its second operand parameter.
SafeMath.div divides its first operand parameter.
SafeMath.div divides by its second operand parameter.
transfer invokes SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
mint invokes SafeMath.add for supply and balance updates.
_burn invokes SafeMath.sub for balance and supply reductions.

normalization_plan.reason: The staged owner parameter exists only to feed the transferOwnership state write.
tokenOwner is merely the lookup key for balanceOf's balances read.
spender is the delegated address consumed by approve's allowance write.
to is the recipient key used by transfer's balance write.
tokens is the amount consumed by transfer's SafeMath arithmetic.
from is the source key consumed by transferFrom's balance and allowance updates.
_to is only the destination key of mint's balance credit.
_amount is only consumed by mint's checks and SafeMath addition.
_value is only consumed by burn and forwarded to _burn.
_who is only the account key burned by _burn.
tokenAddress solely determines the target of the external call operation.
a is the first operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
b is the second operand of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
c is the local result variable returned by the SafeMath helpers.
